hooks.command: INPUT=$(cat); FILEPATH=$(echo "$INPUT" | jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // ""'); echo "$FILEPATH" | grep -q 'pct/__init__\.py' && { VER=$(grep -oP '(?<=__version__ = ")[\d.]+' "$FILEPATH"); [ -n "$VER" ] && sed -i "s/^#  version: .*/#  version: $VER/" railway.toml && echo "[hook] railway.toml aggiornato a v$VER"; } || true
